notes: Run of 2026-11-25. Two Standard stories queued. Published: Google's first San Francisco store, leased in the former Tory Burch space at 222 Stockton. The data-centre moratorium names no address.

findings.description: A Google Store, Google's first in San Francisco, will open next year in the former Tory Burch space at 222 Stockton on the corner of Maiden Lane, on a long-term lease; Tory Burch left this year after a decade.

extra.previous_occupant: Tory Burch (left 2026 after a decade-long lease)

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “Google to open first SF store as tech companies flock to Union Square,” 24 November 2026

raw.text: A Google Store will open in the former Tory Burch space at 222 Stockton St. on the corner of Maiden Lane .

publish.note: Existing page. The Standard's account is readable in full and was published before The Registry's (2026-11-25-rg-0001, declined as a second account). The building's owner, an organisation, and the people quoted are not recorded.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 222 STOCKTON ST → parcel 0309014; sf-parcels has blklot 0309014 active, 218–222 STOCKTON; the 2025 roll records it as commercial misc, built 1908. EAS puts 218, 222 STOCKTON ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 218.
